## Purpose

Standalone walkthrough of the soil-texture kriging that produces Study 2's
derived spatial covariates, calling `3_analysis/R/functions_soil_survey.R`
directly. `plot_depth_kriging()`'s colour ramp was fixed as part of this
pass -- see the function's docstring in `functions_soil_survey.R`.

```{r setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(gstat)
library(terra)

source(here("3_analysis", "R", "functions_soil_survey.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "plot_theme.R"))
```

## Step 1: Read the combined soil survey workbook

```{r read}
soil_data <- load_soil_survey_xlsx(
  here("1_input_data", "soil_survey", "SOIL_SURVEY_DATA_COMBINED.xlsx")
)
soil_data |> glimpse()
```

## Step 2: Convert to an sf point layer and build the interpolation grid

```{r sf-grid}
soil_sf <- soil_survey_to_sf(soil_data)
grid_sf <- build_kriging_grid(soil_sf)

cat("Depth bands present:", paste(unique(soil_sf$depth_cm_streamlined), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Grid cells:", nrow(grid_sf), "\n")
```

## Step 3: Krige every depth x texture-variable combination

Ordinary kriging with a manually specified spherical variogram per
combination (see `krige_manual()`'s docstring for the psill/range/nugget
choices).

```{r krige-all}
kriging_results <- krige_all_depths_variables(soil_sf, grid_sf)
names(kriging_results)
```

Equivalently, in one call: `krige_soil_covariates(soil_survey_xlsx_path)`.

## Step 4: Kriging maps

```{r map-sand-topsoil}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 6
plot_depth_kriging(kriging_results, soil_sf, depth_tag = "0-30", variable = "sand")
```

```{r map-clay-subsoil}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 6
plot_depth_kriging(kriging_results, soil_sf, depth_tag = "30-60", variable = "clay")
```
